name: MMAG Holdings Berhad
overview: MMAG Holdings Berhad 在2026年通过子公司 MJets Air 签署协议，以280万美元出售一架 Boeing B737-400SF 飞机；同时终止了此前拟以2590万美元收购一架飞机的交易。集团还就经常性关联交易寻求股东授权，并提议将已发行股本削减最多1.3亿令吉。
overview_en: In 2026, MMAG Holdings Berhad, through its subsidiary MJets Air, entered into an agreement to dispose of a Boeing B737-400SF aircraft for USD2.8 million, and terminated a proposed acquisition of an aircraft for USD25.9 million. The group also sought shareholder mandate for recurrent related party transactions and proposed a share capital reduction of up to RM130 million.

segments.name: 航空业务
segments.note: 今年航空板块进行了飞机出售和收购终止等资产调整。
segments.note_en: The aviation segment underwent asset adjustments this year, including an aircraft disposal and termination of an acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 MJets Air 与 Mont Gabanon Airlines 签订飞机购买协议，以280万美元现金出售一架 Boeing B737-400SF 飞机。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary MJets Air entered into an Aircraft Purchase Agreement with Mont Gabanon Airlines to dispose of a Boeing B737-400SF aircraft for a total cash consideration of USD2.8 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 集团终止了此前拟以2590万美元收购一架飞机的交易。
actions.text_en: The group terminated its previously proposed acquisition of an aircraft for USD25.9 million.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面推进股本削减和关联交易授权等公司行动。
segments.note_en: At the group level, corporate actions such as share capital reduction and related party transaction mandates were pursued.

actions.title: PROPOSED REDUCTION BY UP TO RM130,000,000 OF THE ISSUED SHARE CAPITAL OF MMAG HOLDINGS BERHAD PURSUANT TO SECTION 117 OF THE COMPANIES ACT 2
actions.text: 将已发行股本削减最多1.3亿令吉。
actions.text_en: Proposed reduction of up to RM130,000,000 of the issued share capital pursuant to Section 117 of the Companies Act 2016.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以进行经常性关联交易。
actions.text_en: Proposed shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature.
